title: 建築デザイン論
subtitle: Method of Architectural Design
educationalGoal: Higher class of Introduction to Architecture. Learns from architectural ideas that capture culturally and artistically the buildings that are the vessels of human activity. Analyze and consider various architectural designs and to think about what is excellent architecture based on the background of the times. In addition, the goal is to learn about the design methods to apply and develop the knowledge to the creation of works for architectural exercises A and B and Project Design Ⅲ.
advice:
Conduct the following lectures related to architectural design.

1.Keywords to decipher architectural design
2.Change and Growth in Architecture
3.The origin of the image and the narrative
4.Evaluation of architectural design
5.World Square and gardens
6.Inner / outer boundary and environmental device
7.Landscape design
8.Spatial production of approach
9.Architectural design inherited over time
10.Kanazawa's architectural culture
11.Travel and see architecture
12.Spatial concept of OKU
13.Supporting and surrounding
requiredKnowledge: Completed the first semester of Introduction to Architecture and the third and fourth semester of history of Japanese and Western architecture, no need any special background knowledge or skills.

activityGoals.body: Understand the roles and characteristics of the Architecture including the historical background.
Analyze and evaluate architecture and urban space and use these results to create new architectural spaces.
Understand the relationship between historical background and architectural design philosophy.
Understand the trends and cutting-edge trends in contemporary architectural design and apply them to own design.

achievementLevels.ideal: Analyze and explain the conditions such as function, composition, beauty, etc. according to the use required of the architectural space, and the characteristics and role of the building (group) that forms the area including the climate and the historical background. Recognized how important the design philosophy and ideas were, and applied these to own works. Discuss the design philosophy and the uniqueness of the design, and gain the understanding of third parties.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the conditions such as function, composition, beauty, etc. according to the use required of the architectural space, and the features and roles of the architecture (group) that forms the area including the climate and historical background. Recognizing how important the design philosophy and ideas are, and applying them to architectural design courses.
